Our event coordinators manage flow and logistics so you can stay present with family and friends. Hold your ceremony on the water or before departure-most couples prefer a single, seamless cruise that transitions naturally into the reception. services.name: Blue Whales
services.desc: Harbor Breeze Cruises has provided public whale watching cruises in Los Angeles, whale watching cruises in Long Beach, whale watching cruises in Santa Monica waters, and whale watching cruises in Newport Beach waters for the past 18 years. Our experienced crew along with educators from the Aquarium of the Pacific will guide you through the journey as we search for breathtaking marine mammals including whales and dolphins. All of our vessels including our state-of-the-art catamarans; La Espada, Triumphant, and Christopher are all eco-friendly and are low-emission.
